seo.description: Common questions about ordering, lead times, and caring for Aizu cotton.

props.heading: Before you write to us
props.subheading: Most questions have an answer here already.

items.question: How long does a made-to-order piece take?
items.answer: Three to four months. The mill weaves the cloth after you order, and the garment is cut once the cloth is finished.

items.question: What if the fabric I want is out of stock?
items.answer: Out of stock does not mean unavailable. If the mill can still weave it, the piece is made to order. A fabric is only marked unavailable when it genuinely cannot be woven again.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: In-stock pieces are paid in full at checkout. Made-to-order pieces are a deposit up front with the balance due when the piece is finished.

items.question: Can I order in-stock and made-to-order together?
items.answer: Yes. The order splits automatically — the in-stock part ships immediately, the made-to-order part ships when it is complete. Each shipment is tracked separately.
